structured_output.what_is_happening: A 13-minute-old pump.fun coin, "Jean Phil Trump" ($JEANTRUMP), sits at about $40k market cap, close to its all-time high of about $44k. It is up about 1000% on the hour, with $111k of volume, 322 unique buyers and 211 unique sellers. The bonding curve holds 103.1 of the ~115 virtual SOL needed to migrate. At least three other "Jean Phil Trump" clones launched in the same ~7-minute window. Each drew $13k–$25k of hourly volume and then died near $3.4k market cap. That burst of clones points to a real outside trigger: a Trump haircut joke, going by the description "They did a tremendous job on my new haircut". This coin won the clone race.
